spec.name: Reversal v17
spec.notes: Mean reversion of recent returns across names.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.3, annual return 8%, maximum drawdown 3%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses `ts_sum(ret,2)` which likely incorporates future information (lookahead bias) because it sums returns over a time window. The backtest uses the full sample without any out-of-sample testing, raising concerns about overfitting. While the Sharpe ratio and drawdown appear attractive, the potential for lookahead bias and lack of out-of-sample validation necessitate paper trading before considering real capital deployment.
